title: Read and write UTF-8

blocks.md:
## Files stay under the run folder

`fs.readFileSync("note.txt", "utf8")` reads the fixture. `fs.writeFileSync("out.txt", text)` writes beside it.

Print the trimmed contents of `note.txt` (`north`).

choices.md: You get a string of text

blocks.promptMd: > Read `note.txt` as UTF-8, trim, print it. Also write the same text to `out.txt`.

description: Read and write a text file on disk.
